name: execute_action_dag
description: Executes a compound Speculative Action DAG in a fast closed loop. Resolves step dependencies topologically, passes variables between steps ({{steps.id.result}}), verifies visual reaction (<30ms) between steps, and provides automatic adaptive reflection and error recovery snapshots on failure.

auto_verify.description: Whether to verify interactive steps with visual servoing.

steps.description: List of action step objects in the DAG.

action.description: Tool or action name to execute (e.g. 'com_explorer', 'launch_app', 'click', 'type_text', 'hotkey', 'com_excel').

args.description: Arguments dictionary for the action. Supports template variables e.g. {{steps.s1.result.path}}.

depends_on.description: List of step IDs that must succeed before executing this step.

on_failure.description: 'abort' stops execution and captures reflection snapshot; 'continue' logs error and proceeds.

retries.description: Number of retries if step or verification fails.

verify.description: Verification strategy: 'auto' (servoing for clicks/keys), 'visual' (strict ImageChops delta/window check), 'none'.

stop_on_error.description: Whether to halt the DAG upon any step failure.
